Affordable NDT ERP in La Porte: running an inspection business on the Houston Ship Channel

An affordable NDT ERP in La Porte has to fit one of the busiest petrochemical inspection markets in North America: back-to-back plant turnarounds, contractor safety requirements that got stricter after serious local incidents, container-terminal and marine work at the port, and clients who want signed reports and clean invoices without chasing. The Atlantis ERP solution puts certifications, calibration, scheduling, reports, quotes and invoices in one system configured for NDT companies. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable, quote on request.

La Porte sits between two of the Ship Channel's big industrial areas, the Battleground Industrial District along the channel and the Bayport Industrial District to the south, with Port Houston's Barbours Cut and Bayport container terminals at either end. Inside a short drive are polyolefin and acetyls plants, specialty chemical and resin makers, industrial gas facilities, and the refineries and chemical complexes of Pasadena, Deer Park and Baytown. Atlantis NDT is based in Houston, so this is home ground.

The market is large, and so is the competition. Owners here have deep contractor benches and switch quickly when a vendor's paperwork slows them down. For a small or mid-size NDT company, being technically good isn't enough. You also have to show qualifications instantly, have calibrated equipment where it's needed, and deliver reports and invoices in the owner's format first time. This section explains how the Atlantis ERP helps with that, using only what the software actually does.

What La Porte's incident history means for contractor records

Two U.S. Chemical Safety Board investigations in La Porte put contractor training, procedures and safety management records under scrutiny. An NDT company can't control an owner's process safety, but it can make sure its own competency, procedure and job records stand up to any question. The Atlantis ERP keeps those records dated, linked and retrievable.

In November 2014, a methyl mercaptan release inside a manufacturing building at DuPont's La Porte plant killed four workers. The CSB's final report in 2019 pointed to a flawed engineering design and inadequate safeguards, and listed safety management gaps including auditing and corrective actions, management of change and safe work practices. In July 2021, a release of hot acetic acid at the LyondellBasell La Porte Complex killed two contract workers after a pressure-retaining valve cover's bolts were removed during a repair. The CSB found that the valve design and a lack of a procedure and training for that task contributed.

Neither incident involved NDT. But after them, owners along the channel pay closer attention to what their contractors can prove about training, competency and procedures. For an inspection company, that means being able to show quickly that each technician was qualified and trained for the task, that the work followed a controlled procedure, and that any finding went through a documented corrective action. The certification, procedure and NCR/CAPA records described below are how the Atlantis ERP supports that. If contractor pre-qualification is costing you bids, ask for a La Porte demo focused on contractor records.

Technician certification tracking software that holds up at the gate

At a Ship Channel plant gate, certification tracking comes down to one thing: can you show this technician's current qualification for this method in seconds? The Atlantis ERP records each certification with scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments, and works out status automatically.

Schemes include SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other, with levels from trainee to III. Most channel owners expect SNT-TC-1A or CP-189-based employer certification. State-issued credentials, such as the industrial radiographer certification Texas requires, can be recorded under the other scheme with their own expiry and alerts. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours.

Status shows as active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked, with Expiring Soon and Expired menus. Warning tasks are created 90 days before any certificate or vision test expires, and daily email alerts go to the people you choose with configurable look-ahead days and resend interval. Vision tests record near vision to Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and file. Exam sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score (70% by default) with the papers attached.

Surveys can be used for competency questionnaires, for example a short check on a client's site-specific procedure, so there is a dated record that the technician was briefed. The employee NDT profile holds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, and timesheets flag hours logged by anyone whose certificate isn't valid. See the certificates app.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for overlapping Ship Channel turnarounds

Turnarounds along the channel often overlap, and the scheduler's job is to spread limited qualified people and calibrated equipment across several owners without double-booking anyone. In the Atlantis ERP each job is a team assignment that moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, and the system blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers.

The technician availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps. Time off requests feed it directly. Put each owner's site orientation on the calendar as training, and projects carry safety induction and work permit fields, so the coordinator can see who has already been through orientation at LyondellBasell, INEOS or a Bayport chemical plant before assigning them there.

Assignments hold site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Technician status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date show in calendar, kanban and list views. If an out-of-calibration instrument is assigned, the scheduler gets a warning. When one owner extends a turnaround by a week, the coordinator can see straight away which other jobs that affects and who is free to cover.

Gulf Coast weather adds another variable. After a hurricane or tropical storm, like Beryl in July 2024, owners want post-storm checks done quickly while crews are also dealing with damage at home. The availability calendar and utilisation view show what capacity you really have, so you commit to what you can deliver. See the team assignments app.

Calibration management software for a shared instrument pool

A La Porte NDT company's equipment moves between several plants and crews in a single week, and calibration management software has to keep up. The Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with calibration frequency, status and full history, and warns if an out-of-calibration item is put on a job.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register stores the lab's accreditation number, the PDF and a valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Purchasing records vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, with accreditation number and expiry, and a repair or recalibration order can be linked to the exact equipment serial.

Items carry equipment type, asset tag, firmware, accessories, condition and a lifecycle state: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Issue and return need supervisor and manager approval, with condition recorded both ways. Reservations prevent clashes, and inbound and outbound movements are logged. Humidity and heat on the Gulf Coast are hard on probes, cables and batteries, and the maintenance log (preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update, probe replacement, with condition before and after) shows which units keep failing. Rental rates can be recorded for equipment you hire out or in.

Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, particle bath and PPE are tracked with reorder levels, low-stock flags and a movement ledger. See the asset management app.

NDT reporting software for olefins, acetyls and terminal work

Ship Channel owners want reports that match their format, reference their drawings and arrive signed. The Atlantis ERP offers 17 report types with separate numbering, moving each report through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures, plus an authorised or third-party inspector's name and signature where required.

The types are UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography, which covers most of what channel plants buy: thickness surveys on process piping, PAUT and TOFD on welds, IRIS and eddy current on exchanger tubing, PMI on alloy piping, hardness after PWHT, MFL on tank floors, and holiday testing on coated lines. Method-specific fields include the UT probe calibration table, RT source and IQI details, MT particle type, PT developer, PAUT focal laws, MFL scan mode and item lines, and UT thickness readings by direction. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation.

Reports reference work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard. The offline field app works inside exchangers' shell sides, tanks and heavily shielded buildings, stores drafts and photos locally, captures signatures and syncs later. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your branding, and a client's own Excel form can be filled automatically by mapping fields to cells.

Container-terminal crane and structure work at Barbours Cut and Bayport uses the same MT, UT and VT reports. For owners who want findings on a 3D model with thickness and remaining-life trends, Atlantis Digital Twins covers that. Reporting is also sold as Digital Twin Reporting Software. API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services are available separately through Atlantis inspection services.

Procedures and NCR/CAPA records an owner's contractor group can audit

Owners along the channel audit contractor procedures and corrective actions, especially after an incident anywhere in the industry. The Atlantis ERP keeps each NDT procedure under revision control, with a snapshot of every revision, approved revisions locked, and dated records of who prepared, reviewed and approved it.

Procedures record document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or an attached file. They move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected (a reason is required) and archived states, and approvers get email reminders. For a new owner specification, an AI-assisted first draft can speed things up, with a built-in template as fallback, and your Level III reviews and approves it.

NCR and CAPA workflows are configured during implementation to fit your quality system, so a non-conformance links to the job, report, technician and equipment, and the corrective action links to any procedure revision it caused. When an owner's contractor safety or quality group asks what changed after a finding, you can show the record. Every report references the procedure used, which closes the trace from finding to procedure to people. See the procedures app.

Quoting and invoicing that fit channel owners' purchasing rules

Large Ship Channel owners run strict accounts-payable checks, and invoices that don't match the PO get sent back. The Atlantis ERP builds invoices from approved timesheets with the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector in the header and labour, equipment and consumables subtotalled separately.

Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF. Accepted and signed online, a quotation becomes a sales order and a project with client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned people and equipment, and induction and permit fields. Project tasks can hold method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references.

Timesheets log inspection, travel, standby and setup by method, site, client and equipment serial, with a billable flag, rate multiplier and approval. On a channel turnaround, where waiting for permits and gas tests eats hours, recording standby as its own work type is how it gets billed. Invoice lines can show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Expenses are re-billed to jobs. Texas tax settings are configured during implementation. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over 12 months. See the quotations and invoicing apps.

Integrations, CRM and getting started from Houston

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections. What gets connected is scoped per implementation. Small La Porte companies often keep QuickBooks while the ERP runs operations, and larger contractors may send approved report data into an owner's maintenance system. Field devices use endpoints for assigned jobs, issued equipment, report submission and sync.

The CRM tracks service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, and scores leads 0 to 100 as hot, warm, nurture or cold. With this many owners within a few miles, that scoring helps decide which bids to chase. Business cards from Houston-area industry events can be photographed and turned into leads in one click. Leads can go into drip email sequences by service line, with AI-written campaign emails from a model that can run on your own server. Dashboards cover calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring or expired, and equipment overdue for return.

Implementation is run by Atlantis NDT from Houston, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III. It usually starts with certificates and equipment, then team assignments and field reports for one crew, then quotations and invoicing. If you run internal SNT-TC-1A-based training, the eLearning app and Practical NDT can support it. Request a written scope for your La Porte operation.

Frequently asked questions

What is the most affordable NDT ERP for a small La Porte inspection company?

One that comes ready for NDT work, so you don't pay to build certification, calibration and report features from scratch. The Atlantis ERP does, you start with the apps you need, and pricing is quote on request.

Can it show a technician's certification at the plant gate?

Yes. Status is calculated automatically and visible from a phone, with certificate attachments, vision tests and exam records on the technician's profile.

Does it track site inductions and work permits?

Yes. Projects have safety induction and work permit fields, and orientation days can be recorded on the availability calendar.

Can we record Texas radiographer credentials?

Yes. State-issued credentials are recorded under the other scheme with their own expiry and 90-day warnings, next to SNT-TC-1A certifications.

Does the ERP handle NCR and CAPA?

Yes. NCR/CAPA workflows are configured during implementation and can be linked to jobs, reports, technicians, equipment and procedure revisions.

What training does Atlantis offer?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training only. API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services are offered separately through Atlantis inspection services.

How do we get a quote?

Request a La Porte quote with your headcount, methods and main clients.
